Package game.pests

Class SlimeGround

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Ground
game.positions.TemporaryGround
game.pests.SlimeGround
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable
public class SlimeGround extends TemporaryGround
Slime left by a SlimeSnail. It covers bare farm ground for a few turns and then dries, putting the original ground back.

It is not Plantable, so nothing can be planted on a slimed tile until the slime dries.

It lives in the pests package, next to the snail that makes it, so the positions package does not depend on pests.
